humanRequest: Continue improving and verify the app; then rethink the solution carefully.

rootFindings.issue: Catalog discovery is not cross-provider identity or a checkout quote.
rootFindings.evidence: PublicCatalog.kt preserves public vendor/meal IDs, but AppGraph.addPublicMeal creates the canonical request from names only. Native restaurant search chooses a name candidate. Branch/address equivalence is not established.
rootFindings.nextContract: Retain source vendor/meal/area references as selection provenance; separately observe and bind each provider's real branch, delivery context, product, size and modifiers. A source ID must never be treated as the other provider's ID or an accessibility selector. Ambiguous suggestions need explicit selection, never silent fuzzy substitution.

rootFindings.issue: UI product configurators are broader than actual native preparation support.
rootFindings.evidence: PlainComparisonSupport, PreviewEvidence and plain native executors support only one or two plain lines. An empty-notes Keeta product layout remains unsupported without a recorded native structure.
rootFindings.nextContract: Extend an observed product-layout reader and options executor together, with the same request and post-add whole-cart proof. Do not merely remove admission limits or infer the missing structure from screenshots.

rootFindings.issue: Cart management needs positive empty-state recovery as well as repeat protection.
rootFindings.evidence: BasketMutationJournal preserves an unresolved native edit across app restart. Manual provider-cart deletion does not clear it. Missing menu footer alone cannot prove a previously seen basket is now empty.
rootFindings.nextContract: Observe an actual provider-native empty-cart state, bind version/restaurant/time, consume reset evidence once and then clear only the corresponding pending ownership record. Native cart replacement requires observed contents and a bounded deletion-confirmation adapter. Local draft deletion must not erase native ambiguity.

rootFindings.issue: Single- and two-item menu reading had divergent routes and timeout behavior.
rootFindings.evidence: Single-item HS reading searched only by scrolling; two-item reading already used guarded native in-menu search with a recorded 8.0.303 fixture.
rootFindings.implemented: Reuse openHungerPlainProduct and scoped search close for one-item reads. Both one-item provider reads now use MenuReadTimeoutBoundary: nested local read timeout leaves that provider unavailable, while parent cancellation, whole-session deadline and safety interruptions still stop everything. New Android wiring is not phone-verified.

rootFindings.issue: Full comparison could start without checking the second adapter's capabilities.
rootFindings.implemented: ComparisonPreflight checks request shape, consent, allowed providers, unique installation records and known versions before either provider opens. Legacy Keeta remains single-item only. Detailed failures are no longer hidden behind the UI's generic start error.

rootFindings.issue: Prepared basket records did not reject inconsistent row sums.
rootFindings.implemented: Complete records now require every line amount and subtotal. All-known amounts must sum exactly with checked arithmetic; mismatches and overflow reject readiness. Subtotal remains items only, never substituted for final review total.

deliveryArchitecture.catalog: Public HTML/catalog cache updates independently without opening provider apps. Current JobScheduler request is every 30 minutes subject to Android scheduling; it does not promise immediate or continuous updates. Saved data must retain source and age.
deliveryArchitecture.comparison: Only explicit Compare opens native apps sequentially. Observe complete current contents first, reconcile exact requested differences, dispatch each edit once, then require the matching complete post-edit basket before a review read.
deliveryArchitecture.result: Separate menu item subtotal, provider review total and verified equivalent-context ranking. Do not infer missing fees/discounts or label the cheapest until branch/address/item/options equivalence is established.
deliveryArchitecture.resume: After interruption, reobserve current state and durable pending edits; never replay an Add from the last screen position.
deliveryArchitecture.hiddenNativeReading: AccessibilityService active-window access is not a hidden provider-data feed. Silent background work belongs to the public catalog source; native review reading needs visible provider navigation.

completionCriteria: Normal APK Compare from two positively empty baskets, all requested rows and quantities verified, fresh final review totals shown together.
Repeat Compare on unchanged request dispatches zero Adds and zero unnecessary quantity edits.
Quantity change updates only the requested difference; interruption/restart and manually emptied native cart recover without duplicates.
Changed restaurant and pre-existing foreign cart follow an explicit observed replacement flow.
Both provider handoffs revalidate full contents and fresh review, never confirm an order or payment.
Product options/layout coverage is tested across actual different restaurant schemas; closed/minimum-order/network conditions give specific recoverable outcomes.
Real delivery context and branch equivalence established before verified cheapest ranking.

localVerification.newTests: 6 preflight cases and 3 basket-money consistency cases
localVerification.existingEvidenceCoverage: Recorded HS native menu-search fixture and existing nested timeout/cancellation/safety regression tests remain passing.
localVerification.warning: Default output APK is now an unreleased same-version local candidate; published 1.3.11 remains work/published-1-3-11.apk. Never overwrite or distribute this candidate as the published asset.
